description: hf_hydrodata is the HydroFrame Python interface to hydrological model inputs, simulation outputs and point observations. It provides a shared query syntax for selecting datasets, variables, geographic areas and time periods. The documented catalogue includes ParFlow-CONUS products, meteorological forcing and observations from public monitoring services. A modeller can obtain consistent inputs and calibration observations for groundwater, water-supply or flood simulations across the continental United States. Resolution and period vary by dataset; model output is explicitly distinguished from measured observations. The software source is freely available on GitHub under MIT. A limitation is that service use requires a HydroFrame API account and registered PIN, and the data-use policy is separate from the software licence. No directly related catalogue record was established. This review read the public repository, licence and paper summary; it did not create credentials, call protected data endpoints or download observations.
